title: Kids story - Baby Moses in the Basket

parts.style: warm, gentle bedtime welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Here we are again, at the quiet end of the day. <short pause> Get nice and comfy... <short pause> because tonight's story is about a tiny baby, a little basket, and a big, wide river.

A long, long time ago, in the land of Egypt, there lived a mother who had a brand new baby boy. <short pause> She loved him very much. <short pause> But it was not a safe time for little baby boys, and she wanted to keep him safe more than anything in the world.

So she made a plan. <short pause> She gathered tall reeds from beside the river, and she wove them together, over and under, over and under, into a little basket. <short pause> She painted it with sticky tar, so that not one drop of water could get in.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Then she wrapped her baby in a soft blanket, and laid him gently inside. <short pause> She carried the basket down to the river, and set it among the tall reeds at the water's edge, where the water moved slowly and softly.
The baby's big sister, Miriam, hid nearby to watch. <short pause> She was very quiet. <short pause> She didn't take her eyes off the little basket, not even for a moment.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: The basket rocked gently on the water, like a cradle. <short pause> The reeds swayed in the breeze. <short pause> A dragonfly buzzed past. <short pause> And inside, the baby slept... <short pause> safe and warm.

Then Miriam heard voices. <short pause> The princess of Egypt had come down to the river with her helpers. <short pause> And she saw something floating among the reeds. <short pause> What could that be?

She sent one of her helpers to bring it to her. <short pause> She lifted the lid... <short pause> and there was the baby! <short pause> He began to cry, and the princess's heart filled with love for him. <short pause> I will take care of this little one, she said.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling, a soft smile in the voice
parts.text: Brave Miriam stepped out from her hiding place. <short pause> Would you like me to find someone to help you care for the baby? she asked. <short pause> Yes, please, said the princess. <short pause> And who do you think Miriam ran to get? <short pause> The baby's very own mother!

So the baby went home with his mother, to be held and fed and loved, until he was big enough to live with the princess. <short pause> She named him Moses. <short pause> And God had a very big plan for Moses, all through his life.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Even when Moses was too small to know it, God was watching over him. <short pause> Floating on the river, God was there. <short pause> And God watches over you, too, little one. <short pause> When you are awake, and when you are fast asleep.

Dear God, <short pause> thank You for watching over baby Moses, and for watching over me. <short pause> Thank You for the people who love me and keep me safe. <short pause> Please hold me gently through the night. <short pause> Amen.
The river is quiet. <short pause> The basket is safe. <short pause> And you are cozy in your own little bed. <short pause> Goodnight, sweet one.
